name: 33602 · Tampa, FL
findings: ZIP 33602 (Tampa) has 246 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 97 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33602 (Tampa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33602 (Tampa) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
